title: 1812: the gathering's camps come and go with the date
items: The Potawatomi and Miami camps by the fort now stand only on the days of the August 1812 gathering (12 to 16 August). On any other date their lodges, their bare camp ground and the paths between them are gone, and that ground is open prairie again.
Set Season to Summer, or follow a jaunt dated in mid-August, to see the camps with their people. The old trails along the banks and the lake shore are there every day of the year.
